name: Dungeon Guide: On Enter, may banish 2 random from memory to level up your champion
notes: Dungeon Guide's On Enter ability (enterAbilities["em6eEh9q8y:0"]) only offers its YESNO if the controller has at least 2 cards in memory, then (on YES) banishes exactly 2 random cards from memory via engine RNG (GetLevelUpMaterialIndices($player, true), higherLevelOnly) and, if a legal one-level-higher champion exists in material, materializes it directly via DoMaterialize -- unlike a generic champion-swap FSM click, this path is not gated to the material-phase MZMAYCHOOSE window, so it can be played and resolved in one shot during turn 1 MAIN. Reused lorraine-wandering-warrior-levelup's exact deck/material setup (default level-0 Spirit of Fire champion with the level-1 Lorraine, Wandering Warrior seeded in material as the only legal target) but seeded a second floating-memory filler card so the starting memory zone has 2 cards before Dungeon Guide's own 3-memory materialization cost is paid (paying memory cost moves cards from hand into memory, same mechanic as reserve payment but landing in the memory zone instead of being spent) -- by the time the On Enter ability fires, memory has 5 cards (2 seeded + 3 paid), satisfying the >=2 check with room to spare. The 2 banished card IDs are RNG-seed-dependent and were confirmed via a direct engine probe against this exact deck/seed before being hardcoded as an expected zone count rather than specific card identities (the specific cards banished aren't part of the printed rule; only the count and the resulting champion swap are).

rulesClauses: On Enter: You may banish two cards at random from your memory. If you do, level up your champion.
